verdict: Yes, for a team with clinical partners. Aignosis from Jaipur pitched early screening and detection of autism on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal. Early diagnosis improves outcomes, but India has few specialists, and tools must be clinically validated.
angle: Many children with autism are diagnosed late because specialists are scarce. Screening tools help paediatricians and schools identify children early. Clinical validation and therapy partnerships are essential.
